description: This Java class demonstrates how to implement bitmap printing in an Android application. It shows an image and provides a print option via the menu, utilizing the support library's PrintHelper to facilitate printing of the displayed bitmap.

classes.name: PrintBitmap
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates printing an image bitmap using PrintHelper, including menu options to trigger the print process.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and references the ImageView.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu with printing options.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, triggering the print process when the print menu item is selected.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Creates a PrintHelper, configures it, retrieves the bitmap from the ImageView, and initiates printing.
